acceptance.criterion: Full file decodes; exact metadata, hashes and provider cost preserved.
Native target dimensions, approximately six seconds, 24fps, silent H264 fast-start web derivative with matching poster.
Complete fish and fine fins retain margins throughout actual desktop/tablet/phone cover crops; no overlap with quiet text zones.
Retain one recognizable striped fish, stable anatomy and natural habitat; no UI or text burned into movie.
Subtle actual fin and habitat motion, no dramatic camera/subject movement; inspect three loop joins, no flash, jump or doubled subject.

constraints.camera: Locked single camera, no travel, zoom, reframing, shake or cuts.
constraints.character: One same silver/black striped angelfish facing left with gold dorsal tint, entire long fins intact; preserve scale, position, orientation and anatomy from exact reference. No new fish.
constraints.environment: Quiet dark left half and full fish at right with all fin margins intact. No text, UI, logo, particles added, animal or foreground props.
constraints.lighting: Gentle stationary surface light and slight natural water shimmer, no pumping exposure or flashing. Reading zone remains dark.
constraints.materials: Preserve natural fish stripes, delicate fins, plant texture, wood grain and photographic deep teal habitat.
constraints.motion: Fish hovers at its exact reference position with only subtle pectoral fin breathing; restrained natural plant and water motion. No swimming through copy zone. Return to opening pose for a quiet loop.

references.usage_notes: Coordinator selected draft input for the requested website. No human final-media acceptance or paid authorization implied.
